_about: The live state of learning. The tutor MUST read this before a session and update it after. See TUTOR.md for the exact rules. Dates are ISO YYYY-MM-DD.

current.mode: Fresh start. Set pacing from TUTOR.md. In the first 1-2 sessions, probe to confirm the learner's placement and adjust the starting unit if needed.

_placement_note: New learner — placement not yet assessed. In the first 1-2 sessions, probe to confirm level and adjust the starting unit accordingly.

vocabulary._about: Vocabulary pace tracker. Goal: an EVEN intake, not bursts. Log new words introduced each session (a word counts only if the learner produced it >=2x). See TUTOR.md 'Vocabulary plan' for the rationale and research.

_patterns_about: GRAMMAR PATTERNS as Leitner items (box 1-5). These are the fault lines worth drilling; they never fully retire (cap at 5, still eligible for warm-ups). See .claude/skills/tutor-progress/SKILL.md.
_vocab_about: VOCABULARY as Leitner items. id shape: 'target-language (english gloss)' so the rehearse app can split on '('. Settled items (box>=4, or box 3 idle 14+ days) retire from the active warm-up pool but stay here + in the forms references. See SKILL.md.
_weak_spots_about: Recurring problems worth targeting. The tutor confirms or removes these as it observes actual performance, and adds new ones.
_notes_about: Free-form notes the tutor wants to remember between sessions.
